name: F1 25 RE-Optimization
author: xanpavle (ported by Swofty)
description: xanpavle's renderer optimisation: a tuned graphics delta, in-engine enforcement of the tuned values, engine renderer overrides and a GPU-aware upscaler. Offline single-player only.

options.label: Apply the graphics profile
options.description: Lowers some quality settings as the game reads them: volumetric fog, shadow maps, SSR, SSAO, grass distance, particles, hair, god rays, car reflections, and ray-traced AO and DDGI. Your settings file is not changed. Applies on the next launch.

options.label: Keep ray-traced AO and DDGI
options.description: Leaves ray-traced ambient occlusion and DDGI as you set them. Off, the graphics profile turns both off. Ray-traced shadows and reflections are never changed. Applies on the next launch.

options.label: In-engine enforcement
options.description: Sets the tuned shadow, fog, crowd and texture streaming values in the engine after the graphics preset. Cheaper keeps the lower of yours and the tuned one, Target always uses the tuned one, Off changes nothing. Applies next launch.

options.label: Pin effects
options.description: With enforcement on, keeps sky-shadow low LOD, the 32-bit sky shadow map, crowd shadows, god rays, lens streak and motion blur v2 off. Target also keeps rain, heat haze, ground cover, grass flattening, volumetric fog and night shadows on.

options.label: Upscaler
options.description: Auto picks DLSS on NVIDIA RTX, FSR 3 on AMD and GTX, XeSS on Intel Arc. Keep leaves your in-game choice. The quality level is never changed. Applies on the next launch.

options.label: VRS and async compute
options.description: Forces the engine's variable rate shading and async compute on (Renderer.Gfx.enableVRS, enableAsyncCompute).

options.label: Grass and ground cover caps
options.description: Lowers the engine's grass and ground cover instance caps (groundCoverMaxInstances 40000, groundCover2MaxInstances 80000) and turns off forced ultra ground cover. Lowers grass density.

options.label: Static instance caps
options.description: Lowers the engine's static and PVS render instance caps to 20000. Distant props can pop in; turn this off if they do.

options.label: Log setting reads
options.description: Writes every engine setting read, and each later change, to swofty/loader.log. For troubleshooting; leave off for normal play.
